message.content: I think you can see it: trade gave the pharaohs their power, because it let them collect goods, money, and status; he ruled them, she guided us, and we trusted it. You may ask why it mattered, and I told him that she helped me, we helped them, they helped us, he helped her, and it helped all of them. I believe it made their rule stronger, you can see why, and we should not forget it.
